# [pytorch compile] Incorrect result when `dtype` changes

<!-- DRAFT generated by tcc. Review every section before filing (plan 18.6). -->

## Summary
The compiled execution is inconsistent with Python eager execution when `dtype` changes from `float16` to `(base)`.
all pre-Inductor layers agree and only Inductor differs: lowering / code generation
This test was generated because the static analysis found: numerics depend on precision regardless of source (factor `x.dtype`, oracles ['value', 'metadata']).

## Environment
- Python: 3.12.13
- Framework: PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128
- Compiler backend: inductor
- Commit/version: 449b1768410104d3ed79d3bcfe4ba1d65c7f22c0
- CUDA/ROCm: 12.8
- GPU: Tesla T4
- OS: Linux 6.12.90+
- Triton: 3.6.0

## Minimal Reproducer

```python
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)

def fn(x):
    y = F.logsigmoid(x)
    return y, torch.signbit(y), y == 0, torch.copysign(torch.ones_like(y), y)

args = (torch.randn(1).to(torch.float16),)

eager = fn(*args)
torch._dynamo.reset()
compiled = torch.compile(fn, backend='inductor')(*args)
print('eager   :', eager)
print('compiled:', compiled)
```

## Expected Behavior

Eager/reference result:

```text
structure: P[T,T,T,T]
[0] [-0, -0, -0, -0, -0, -0]
[1] [True, True, True, True, True, True]
[2] [True, True, True, True, True, True]
[3] [-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1]
```

## Actual Behavior

Compiled result:

```text
structure: P[T,T,T,T]
[0] [-0, -0, -0, 0, 0, 0]
[1] [True, True, True, False, False, False]
[2] [False, False, False, True, True, True]
[3] [-1, -1, -1, 1, 1, 1]
```

## Trigger Condition

Changed semantic factor:

```text
dtype: float16 -> (base)
```

Controlled factors:

```text
shape / dtype / stride / device / compile flags: unchanged
```

Execution sequence:

```text
E0_eager: ok

E3_inductor: ok
```

A float64 reference was computed; numeric findings are reported only when the compiled error against that reference exceeds the eager error by more than the configured multiplier.
